C1210.title: Jack Dorsey's Twitter Account Hijacked via SIM Swap Attack
C1210.summary: In 2019, then-Twitter CEO Jack Dorsey fell victim to a SIM swap attack. Attackers deceived or bribed a mobile carrier to transfer his phone number to a controlled SIM card, enabling them to take over his Twitter account and post offensive content. The incident remains a landmark case of SIM swapping targeting high-profile individuals.
